name: Andron's Ledger
summary: Andron's Ledger is an intelligence document obtained from Andron Gant in the Undercity. The Deathstalkers seek it as part of an operative's early work gathering information for the Forsaken.

sections.title: Uncovering the Syndicate
sections.body: Retrieved from Andron Gant's bookshelf within the Undercity, this ledger contains far more intelligence than the Deathstalkers initially anticipated. Its contents reveal that the Syndicate—the remnants of the fallen human nobility of Alterac—is actively maneuvering in the region. Upon reviewing the entries, Deathstalker Mennet Carkad immediately realizes the strategic value of the document, recognizing that the ruined lords of Alterac are scheming once again. The ledger provides the Forsaken leadership with concrete proof of Syndicate operations, turning a routine errand into a major intelligence coup.

sections.title: A Matter for the Dreadlord
sections.body: Because the revelation concerns regional threats to the Forsaken realm, Mennet Carkad dispatches the bearer to carry the ledger directly to Varimathras in the Royal Quarter. As Sylvanas Windrunner's dreadlord majordomo, Varimathras oversees internal security and espionage through the Deathstalkers. The ledger earns Varimathras's commendation, proving both the competence of the Deathstalker network and the reliability of the operative who brought it to light.

faq.answer: It is a record book retrieved from Andron Gant's bookshelf in the Undercity, containing intelligence sought by the Deathstalkers.

Andron Gant is a Forsaken who keeps a shop near the Apothecarium in the Undercity. Lord Varimathras suspected him of secretly aiding an outside group, so the Deathstalkers sent an agent posing as his expected messenger to obtain his ledger.

faq.q: Why do the Deathstalkers want the ledger?
faq.answer: Mennet Carkad wants to examine Andron's information for intelligence useful to the Forsaken.

aliases: who do i bring the ledger to
faq.answer: It is first brought to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter, who evaluates its contents and then instructs that it be delivered directly to Lord Varimathras in the Hall of the Dark Lady.

faq.q: What does delivering the ledger achieve for a rogue?
faq.answer: Delivering the ledger completes the operative's initiation into the Deathstalkers, earning formal induction into the Forsaken's secretive assassin guild.

angles.text: Retrieving and deciphering Andron's Ledger serves as your proving ground, marking your formal induction into the Deathstalkers by Mennet Carkad and earning the personal acknowledgment of Varimathras.
The ledger shows the Forsaken's efforts to gather intelligence on the threats surrounding their new realm.
